d:
Jharkhand sthapna divas ke avsar par rajdhani ranchi ke khelganv men bhavy karyakram ki taiyari jor-shor se chal rahi hai. 28 navanbar ko aayojit hone vale is vishesh samaroh men mukhyamantri hemant soren shamil honge. karyakram ko lekar khelganv men taiyariyon ko antim rup diya ja raha hai.
Is vidiyo men dekhie jharkhand sthapna divas samaroh ki taiyariyon ki puri jhalka. janie khelganv men kya-kya vyavastha ki ja rahi hai aur is bhavy aayojan men kya khas rahne vala hai.
Jharkhand ki sthapna, gauravshali itihas aur vikas ki yatra ko samarpit is samaroh par hamari khas riporta.
